title: China3 finding row
description: One verified finding. Either the topic form (a rule) or the channel form (a route). Rules: a row with verification != 'unverified' MUST carry at least one https source URL that points at an official publisher; a row with verification == 'unverified' MUST NOT carry a value.

verification.description: verified = the value is stated in the linked official source; partial = part of the finding is confirmed; unverified = nothing confirmable was found, so the value is blank.

value.description: Empty string when verification is 'unverified'. No placeholder text allowed.

detail.description: The operative wording of the rule, quoted, with the article number.

implication.description: What the rule means for a US citizen moving CNY to USD.

legality.description: Taken from the official source, not from common practice. 'lawful-restricted' means permitted subject to conditions stated in `restriction`.

capacity.description: Published limit. Empty string if none could be sourced.

cost_published.description: Published cost. Empty string if none could be sourced — never an estimate.
